# zeroword_client (Resource)

An OAuth/OIDC client of an Environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zeroword_client" "web" {
  environment_id             = zeroword_environment.staging.id
  client_type                = "web_spa"
  name                       = "web"
  token_endpoint_auth_method = "none"
  redirect_uris              = ["https://app.example.com/callback"]
  post_logout_redirect_uris  = ["https://app.example.com/"]
  allowed_origins            = ["https://app.example.com"]
  allowed_scopes             = ["openid", "email", "profile", "offline_access"]
  allowed_resources          = ["https://api.example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_type` (String) `web_bff`, `web_spa`, or `react_native`.
- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID (`env_...`).
- `name` (String) Display name (1-200 characters).
- `token_endpoint_auth_method` (String) `none` (public client), `client_secret_basic`, or `client_secret_post`.

### Optional

- `allowed_origins` (Set of String) Allowed CORS origins (max 50). Defaults to empty.
- `allowed_resources` (Set of String) HTTPS resource indicators (audiences) the client may request (max 20). Defaults to empty.
- `allowed_scopes` (Set of String) Scopes the client may request (max 50). Defaults to empty.
- `mobile_app` (Attributes) Native app settings of a `react_native` client. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mobile_app))
- `post_logout_redirect_uris` (Set of String) Allowed post-logout redirect URIs (max 50). Defaults to empty.
- `redirect_uris` (Set of String) Allowed redirect URIs (max 50). Defaults to empty.
- `require_nonce` (Boolean) Whether an `openid` authorization request must carry a `nonce`. Set `false` only for public clients that cannot send one (for example MCP clients); PKCE S256, `state` and the registered redirect URI stay required. Requires Zeroword 0.7.0 or later. Defaults to `true`.
- `require_pkce` (Boolean) Kept for compatibility; Zeroword requires PKCE S256 for every client. Defaults to `true`.
- `status` (String) `active` or `disabled`. Defaults to `active`.

### Read-Only

- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret of a confidential client. Zeroword returns it only at creation, so it is null after import and for public clients.
- `id` (String) Client ID.

<a id="nestedatt--mobile_app"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mobile_app`

Required:

- `app_scheme` (String) Custom URL scheme.

Optional:

- `android_package_name` (String) Android package name.
- `android_sha256_fingerprints` (Set of String) SHA-256 signing certificate fingerprints of the Android app, colon-separated uppercase hex (Zeroword stores the uppercase form, so lowercase input shows a diff on every plan).
- `ios_bundle_id` (String) iOS bundle ID.
- `ios_team_id` (String) Apple Team ID.
- `universal_link_host` (String) Host for iOS Universal Links / Android App Links.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import zeroword_client.web cli_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```
